title: Acknowledgment, Reviewer and Language Access Standards for Appeals and Grievances
content:
Every **Appeals and Grievances** case type carries its own acknowledgment period and acknowledgment channel, its reviewer requirements and its language and format access standards. The standards below apply by case type.

## Standards by case type

| Case type | Acknowledgment sent within (calendar days after the filed date) | Acknowledgment channel | Reviewer took no part in the original decision | Reviewer has clinical expertise in the member's condition | Notices in large print, braille and audio | Interpreter at no cost throughout |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member Grievance | 5 | Mail | Required | Not required | Available | Yes |
| Quality of Care Grievance | 5 | Mail | Required | Required | Available | Yes |
| Standard Appeal | 5 | Mail | Required | Required | Available | Yes |
| Expedited Appeal | 1 | By phone, orally | Required | Required | Available | Yes |
| State Fair Hearing | 0 (the state, not the plan, acknowledges) | Not applicable | Required | Not required | Available | Yes |
| External Medical Review | 0 (the state, not the plan, acknowledges) | Not applicable | Required | Required | Available | Yes |

## The same standards grouped

- **Acknowledged by the plan in writing by mail within 5 calendar days of the filed date:** Member Grievance, Quality of Care Grievance, Standard Appeal.
- **Acknowledged by the plan orally by phone within 1 calendar day of the filed date:** Expedited Appeal.
- **Not acknowledged by the plan (acknowledgment period 0, channel not applicable):** State Fair Hearing and External Medical Review, which the state acknowledges.
- **Reviewer independence:** required for all six case types.
- **Clinical expertise of the reviewer:** required for Quality of Care Grievance, Standard Appeal, Expedited Appeal and External Medical Review; not required for Member Grievance and State Fair Hearing.
- **Accessible formats and interpreters:** large print, braille and audio notices are available, and an interpreter is provided at no cost throughout, for all six case types.
